facts.fact: Eswatini Positive News reports the Macetjeni iHub in the Lubombo Region was officially launched on 6 August 2026 as the second iHub after Piggs Peak, run by a competitively selected young entrepreneur, with a pilot that trained over 100 people and incubation support described as something it will offer.
